title: Novel glycidyl azide polymers containing aromatic diol units: synthesis and characterization for their application as energetic composite propellant binders
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19109-19118
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00798H, Paper

Novel energetic glycidyl azide polymers containing aromatic diol units were synthesized, showing improved glass-transition temperatures, high heat of decomposition, and thermo-mechanical stability.
